create_calendar_event: create a calendar event with title, start and end datetime, tag, description, location, and attendees
search_calendar_events: search calendar events by query string matching title, description, location, and attendees fields
get_events_by_time_range: get calendar events that overlap with a specified start and end datetime range with pagination
delete_calendar_event: delete a calendar event by its event id and return a success confirmation message
get_events_by_tag: get all calendar events filtered by a specific tag value from the calendar
